translated_title: IMSS Announces Plan of 12 Actions in 120 Days; Will Invest 11.745 Billion Pesos
original_title: IMSS anuncia plan de 12 acciones en 120 días; invertirá 11 mil 745 millones de pesos
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: Over half a million health workers get an 8 percent raise, nearly 11,000 temporary staff hired during the pandemic win permanent positions, and 2,500 specialists will be hired.
